blurb: Book one of our Storyteller Characters for your child’s birthday and enjoy a thoughtfully designed celebration full of dress up, facepainting, interactive storytelling, imaginative play, and wonder-led by our professional teaching artists. Available for booking all around the Bay Area and specially designed for children ages 3-8.
